entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This application is filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act for condonation of delay of 283 days caused in preferring the First Appeal.
2. Heard learned advocate Mr.Nishit Bhalodi for the applicant.

Though served, none appeared for respondent No.2.
3.
Learned advocate for the applicant submitted that due to financial crunch, applicant could not manage necessary fees for the purpose of litigation.
There is no intentional delay on the part of the applicant.
Thus, there NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/231/2025 ORDER DATED: 05/03/2025 undefined is a delay in preferring the appeal.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the present applicant is unaware of the provisions of law, which could permit him to file appeal, which is a statutory right.

He has submitted that in view of the settled principles of law in the deceision of Hon'ble Apex Court in case of K. Subbarayadu and others Vs.
The Special Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition) reported in 2017(12) SCC 840 and would submit that considering the law laid down in aforementioned case, the applicant is not claiming his right for the interest upon the enhanced compensation, if any, for the delay period, if appellant succeeds in First Appeal.

entities.text:
K. Subbarayadu and others Vs.
The Special Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition) reported in 2017(12) SCC 840
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the submissions canvassed by the learned advocate for the applicant and contentions raised in the application, it is needless to observe that in catena of decisions, the view taken by the Hon'ble Supreme Court is, while deciding an application for condonation of delay, the liberal and justice orientated approach needs to be adopted so that the substantive rights of the parties are not defeated only on the ground of delay.
To meet with the equity, delay can be condoned.
There is no intentional delay on the part of the applicant.
The delay has sufficiently been explained.

Hence, the delay is condoned NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/231/2025 ORDER DATED: 05/03/2025 undefined subject to condition that the claimant/s shall not claim interest upon enhanced compensation, if any, for the period of delay, if succeeds the appeal.
5. With these observations and directions, the present Civil Application stands allowed.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
